title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate to strong thunderstorms are expected for today.

--- Discussion ---

A strong low pressure system above the nordics already brought warmer air, today a cold front should sweep through Central Europe.

A very interesting mid-september severe weather setup has developed, and Czechia will be the most affected.

Storms firing up in the afternoon near the Ore Mountains (Krušné Hory) and later move into northern Bohemia.
These thunderstorms will be mostly discrete, with the frontal system few km behind it.

The main reason ive decided to issue ENHD was the mesolow with a convergence line right in Central-Northern Bohemia, could locally enhance low-level directional shear and SRH, meaning a tornado could potentially form.

Tornadoes arent ruled out, as the conditions for a weaker tornadoes are there.
If any supercell remains discrete and interacts with the convergence zone, an isolated tornado cannot be ruled out.
